current_thesis: Huarong is a leading explosion-proof electrical equipment company. Low-margin new-energy EPC contraction pressured 2025 and 2026Q1 earnings, but the core explosion-proof business has high margins, overseas revenue is growing, and dividends plus buybacks provide valuation support. At about 15x TTM PE around CNY 15-16, the stock is suitable for staged value buying, with 2026 interim results needed to confirm overseas growth and cash-flow recovery.
